what: Sensitivity of gate 1's first logged loss to legitimate partitions of the same samples, measured with the reference's own code
why: The task allows a candidate to choose how an optimizer step's samples are spread over its micro-batches. The first logged loss is the token-mean cross entropy of each micro-batch, averaged over the micro-batches, so it moves with the partition even when the step trains on exactly the same samples.
quantity: the first entry of bench.py time's logged_loss (before any optimizer step)
rule: tolerance = 2 x the largest observed shift, rounded up to 0.1%, and not below the plain band 0.005
note: Applies only to candidates whose data probe shows a different partition. Which samples each optimizer step trains on is checked exactly by the multiset items of gates 0 and 2, not by this band.
